answer: To forge a fake identity should cost more than it can earn. Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that unbonding releases only after a long delay, while a sable ledger records each agent's history in plain view. New accounts start with near-zero trust and gain it only through slow, verified work, so a flood of fresh identities behaves like a zephyr against a stone wall: visible, but unable to move anything. An attacker must fund and age thousands of accounts before one vote counts.
